Great experience
Oct 2026 • Solo
The dinner setting was absolutely beautiful, with a stunning panoramic view of West Lake. I was lucky enough to visit on the evening of the fireworks celebration, which made the whole experience even more spectacular. The scenery was truly breathtaking.

As I follow a gluten-free diet, Ms. Jang was incredibly helpful and kindly liaised with the kitchen to arrange a lobster dish that suited my dietary requirements. I really appreciated her thoughtful assistance and excellent service.Thank you so much, everyone! ❤️

Outstanding
Jul 2026 • Business
I'm a member of Sino Group, and our group was quite large. We had dinner here, and the restaurant on the 21st floor offers a stunning view. Although I arrived a little late, there was still plenty of food available, and it still served hot and fresh. A waitress named Jang gave me a warm welcome and even kindly brought me a bowl of soup. It was a lovely dinner, and I had a truly memorable experience at Lotte L7 Hanoi Hotel!

Insider tip:
